The '''RT-16 Patrol Droid''' was a model of cold-resistant [[Probe droid/Legends|probe]] [[Sentry droid/Legends|patrol droid]] designed by the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Kerkarr]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to use on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. However, Kerkarr's ship crashed, and his droids went rogue.
